description: This is a shell script containing functions for extracting, patching, and validating calibration data, specifically related to device firmware, UBI volumes, MMC partitions, and MAC address patches.

methods.name: caldata_dd
methods.description: Performs block data transfer using dd with specified source and target, offset, and size.

methods.name: caldata_die
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: caldata_extract
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a partition identified by name.

methods.name: caldata_extract_ubi
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from a UBI volume.

methods.name: caldata_extract_mmc
methods.description: Extracts calibration data from an MMC partition.

methods.name: caldata_extract_reverse
methods.description: Extracts calibration data in reverse byte order.

methods.name: caldata_from_file
methods.description: Copies calibration data from a file source.

methods.name: caldata_sysfsload_from_file
methods.description: Loads calibration data from a file into sysfs attribute.

methods.name: caldata_valid
methods.description: Checks if the calibration data matches expected magic number.

methods.name: caldata_patch_data
methods.description: Patches data into firmware, optionally updating checksum.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address into firmware data.

methods.name: ath9k_patch_mac_crc
methods.description: Patches MAC address with CRC into firmware data.

methods.name: ath10k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address for ath10k devices.

methods.name: ath11k_patch_mac
methods.description: Patches MAC address with specific ID for ath11k devices.

methods.name: ath10k_remove_regdomain
methods.description: Removes regulatory domain settings from firmware.

methods.name: ath11k_remove_regdomain
methods.description: Removes regulatory domain settings for ath11k devices.

methods.name: ath11k_set_macflag
methods.description: Sets MAC flag in firmware data.
